answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 15786 Country: India Title: can i name my daughter azeemah wht is the meaning? Question: can i name my daughter azeemah wht is the meaning? Answer ID: 15786 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1393/1412=L=1430) Azeemah means great, you can keep the name, but it is better to name with names like Maryam, Khadijah, Hafsah, Ayishah, Zainab, Khansa, Juwairiyah, and other Sahabiyat. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
